title: A superquadratic separation of sensitivity and block sensitivity

result.label: A superquadratic separation of sensitivity and block sensitivity
result.statement: Constructs total Boolean functions with block sensitivity bs (f) s(f)^ for a fixed α > 2, disproving the quadratic strengthening of the Sensitivity Conjecture. Here s(f) counts influential individual-bit flips, while block sensitivity allows disjoint groups of bits to change together.
